MOLINE CT. -> Moline Court. The 80 ft street east of the Blue Rock junction is printed only 'AV.' (and 80'); named Spring Grove Avenue from the key map (SPRING GROVE on 626), and the diagonal 60 ft street from 616 is the same avenue (pipe runs continuously). Hamilton's west side (sheet 623) is drawn in outline: Knowlton west and Palm Av. T-junctions recorded from it; Blue Rock crosses. Fergus runs straight through Knowlton (the water pipe jogs east there, the street faces do not); the C.H.&D. R.R. crosses Fergus between Knowlton and Bond. Three unnamed 25 ft streets in the block between Hamilton and Spring Grove south of Blue Rock (block 3): one dead-ends near the Hamilton lots and runs ESE to the Monumental Works yard, one runs diagonally SSW from it, and one runs from Hamilton ESE (20 ft east of the diagonal) off the bottom edge; its meeting with Spring Grove is off the sheet. The scan is rotated about 2 deg (E-W streets descend to the east). Circled numbers are grade elevations.
